name: new
declaration: unsafe fn new < A : Allocator + Clone > (alloc : A) -> Box < Self , A >
documentation:
Creates a new boxed `InternalNode`.

 # Safety
 An invariant of internal nodes is that they have at least one
 initialized and valid edge. This function does not set up
 such an edge.
rules: The caller must establish the invariant that the returned internal node has at least one initialized and valid edge; `new` does not set up such an edge.
